scope: Only original exposed INT pairs dev03_10 and dev03_15; no new method

semantic_profile.value_domain: INT and NULL; source INT32 subdomain included
semantic_profile.input: Any finite bags including duplicates, empty tables and unequal cardinalities
semantic_profile.equality: Ordinary symmetric INT/NULL SQL equality, not NULL-safe equality
semantic_profile.logic: SQL 3VL; ON and WHERE retain only TRUE
semantic_profile.CASE: First TRUE branch in source order; missing ELSE is NULL
semantic_profile.NOT_IN: Same original uncorrelated subquery and same SQL NOT IN on both sides; no rewrite to NOT EXISTS or anti-join
semantic_profile.row_equality: Componentwise ordinary equality joined by 3VL AND; equal two-field row lengths
semantic_profile.null_fill: Builtin IFNULL(x,0) and two-argument COALESCE(x,0) select first non-NULL over pure INT column and literal 0
semantic_profile.output: Unordered bag values and multiplicities; metadata/physical row order not certified
semantic_profile.snapshot: Same database snapshot and schema/name binding; no volatile or side-effect expressions

Same CASE value and NULL status for every FRIENDSHIP occurrence

IFNULL and two-argument COALESCE agree for INT/NULL payloads
All projection collisions and duplicate multiplicities add identically
